image_description: A close-up photograph of a bright green snake, identified as a Green Mamba, resting among dark green foliage. The snake's head is prominent in the foreground, showing a yellowish-green hue on the face and snout, transitioning to emerald green along the body. The scales appear smooth and slightly glossy. The eye is large, dark, and round. The background consists of out-of-focus leaves, creating a naturalistic setting.

The transition from the jaw to the neck seems slightly blurred and structurally ambiguous, lacking a clear anatomical boundary, which may indicate slight generation softness or fusion.
